raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "increase"
  role subject "the rate on the mortgage credit at BCR"
  role object "from 2.340 lei to 2.610 lei"
  polarity affirmed
  valid from "August"
  certainty asserted

@q query
  select ?p
  where match
    relation "increase by what percentage"
    role subject "the rate"
    role object ?p
    polarity affirmed
  end
